item.title: Limitwick 2.1.3
item.description:
Changes

- Widgets: on macOS 27 the desktop widgets stayed empty. macOS 27 no longer lets the widget of a locally signed app read the shared app group container, and a widget cannot ask for that permission. Limitwick now keeps widget snapshots in `~/Library/Application Support/Limitwick/Widget/`, and the widget has read-only access to that folder only. The last values from the old storage are carried over on first launch.

item.title: Limitwick 2.1.2
item.description:
Changes

- Menu bar: when both Codex and Claude are tracked, the bars are now labeled with neutral text labels, CX and CL, instead of the previous symbols, which resembled the providers' logos. - README: Limitwick is an independent project and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Anthropic or OpenAI.

item.title: Limitwick 2.1.1
item.description:
Changes

- Codex activity: Settings now shows whether Codex hooks are installed and whether activity is arriving, with Install Codex hooks and Remove Codex hooks buttons. The Codex activity box stays clear until the hooks are installed; checking it installs them. Previously the box looked enabled even without hooks, and the menu bar showed no activity. - After installing Codex hooks, trust them in Codex Settings → Hooks or with `/hooks` in the Codex CLI, then restart open Codex sessions. Codex does not run hooks that have not been trusted.

item.title: Limitwick 2.1.0
item.description:
Changes

- Red now means only one thing: the remaining quota is below your warning threshold. Themes that used red or orange for the weekly limit use calmer colors instead: blue in Industrial, teal in Capsules, the theme's main color in Dot Matrix and Paper. - When a refresh fails, the panel, Picture-in-Picture window and widgets dim the previous values, as the menu bar already did. With both services shown, the error and the age of the data appear right under the service name. - Reset times lead with the time remaining, for example "in 2h 15m · 4:30 PM" or "in 4d 6h · Sat 8:15 PM". The date is left out for today and the year for this year, and the line wraps only after "·". - Reset times are larger (11 pt) in every theme, and their contrast is higher in Classic (light) and on Capsules fills. - Settings: the Claude sign-in hint appears only when Claude is tracked. With both services shown, Settings for switches between Codex and Claude, and section titles name the service. The threshold has its own Low quota section (Warn below). The Claude activity box stays clear until Claude Code hooks are installed; checking it installs them. - Classic shows the percentage larger than the period letter in the ring. The menu rows stay clear until you point at them, with thin lines around Refresh and Quit. In the dual panel, Terminal no longer repeats the service name. About mentions Claude Code.

item.title: Limitwick 2.0.1
item.description:
Changes

- Fixed Claude limits not loading after the update to 2.0.0. Limitwick runs Claude Code in a new folder, and Claude Code asks whether to trust it. Claude Code could reset the answer to "No, exit" right after showing the question, so Limitwick waited until the timeout. Limitwick now repeats the selection until "Yes, I trust this folder" is chosen.

item.title: Limitwick 2.0.0
item.description:
Changes

- Limitwick no longer uses the CodexBar identifiers. The bundle ID, app group, widget extension and storage folders now use the Limitwick name. - Because the bundle ID changed, Limitwick 2.0 installs as a new app. Version 1.x shows an update notice that links to this page instead of installing it. - On the first launch your settings are copied from the previous version. Installed Claude Code and Codex activity hooks are switched to the new app. If Codex hooks were switched, review and trust them again in Codex Settings → Hooks. - On launch Limitwick quits all copies of version 1.x, including ones named CodexBar.app, moves them to the Trash and lists them. - Desktop widgets must be added again from the widget gallery. macOS asks again for permission to send notifications. - Settings has a button to install Claude Code or sign in to it in Terminal.

item.title: Limitwick 1.13.1
item.description:
Changes

- Settings now warns when another copy of Limitwick is on your Mac. A second copy, for example in Downloads or under the old name CodexBar.app, can make the widget gallery show old widgets after an update. The warning lists the copies and opens them in Finder so you can remove them. - The README troubleshooting section explains how to fix old widgets in the gallery: keep one copy in Applications, move the rest to the Trash, empty the Trash, and log out and back in.

item.title: Limitwick 1.13.0
item.description:
Changes

- Choose from 24 separate medium desktop widgets. Each of the six themes is available in Light and Dark for both Codex and Claude. - Widget appearance is independent of the app panel. Installed widgets can receive limits for a provider hidden from the menu bar while Limitwick is running. - The previous universal widget has been replaced. Open Edit Widgets and add the variants you want.

item.title: Limitwick 1.12.0
item.description:
Changes

- Codex Bar is now called **Limitwick**. The app, menu, About window, notifications and desktop widget use the new name, and release archives are named `Limitwick-<version>-macOS-Apple-Silicon.zip`. - Updating keeps your settings, widget data and installed activity hooks: the bundle identifier, app group and storage folders are unchanged. An app updated in place may keep its old file name in Applications; you can rename it to Limitwick.app if you like. - The README has been rewritten as a full user guide with new images of the menu bar and all panel themes.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.11.2
item.description:
Changes

- Turning on Claude activity in Settings now installs the Claude Code hooks automatically, so they are ready before your next Claude Code session. - Claude Code hooks now use a copy of the helper script in Application Support instead of the app bundle, so they keep working if the app is moved or replaced. Existing hooks are moved to the new location when the app starts. - Settings shows whether the hooks are installed and whether activity is arriving from Claude Code, with a single Install or Remove button. - Clearer instructions after installing hooks: activity appears in Claude Code sessions started afterwards; to include an open session, type /exit, then run `claude --continue`.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.11.1
item.description:
Changes

- Fix the Claude Code activity indicator never appearing in the menu bar: activity display is now on by default for Claude, as it is for Codex. If you turned it off earlier, your choice is kept. - Settings now shows whether the Claude Code hooks are installed, and installing them turns the Claude activity indicator on.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.11.0
item.description:
Changes

- Add Claude Code subscription quota monitoring alongside Codex, with separate five-hour and weekly limits, reset times, additional limits, and error messages. - Show Codex, Claude, or both in the menu bar and popup. Each provider has its own panel theme, light or dark mode, notification options, and warning threshold. - Add an optional Claude Code activity indicator with setup and removal controls for Claude Code hooks. Activity indicators use white animations and occupy space only while active. - Keep per-provider data available in the Picture-in-Picture window and widget. The widget's combined view currently uses a shared simplified style rather than separate provider themes.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.10.1
item.description:
Changes

- Refactor quota refresh scheduling, notification handling, and settings into focused components. - Share app-server connection setup while retaining separate quota and event connections. - Organize interface code by responsibility and add tests for refresh and notification behavior.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.10.0
item.description:
Changes

- Show animated Codex activity beside the menu bar quota bars for supported local sessions. - Display working, tool activity and completion; enable or disable the indicator in Settings. - Improve the size and weight of the activity icons while keeping the existing quota bars.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.9.1
item.description:
Changes

- Refresh the desktop widget using the current theme when Codex Bar starts, and retain available previous values while fresh limits load. - Make the widget image fill its available space and reduce visible borders. - Isolate local development builds and widgets from the installed app to avoid conflicting identifiers and shared data.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.9.0
item.description:
Changes

- Check for compatible updates quietly at launch and once a day, without automatic update pop-ups. - Highlight available updates in the context menu and show the version; selecting it opens Sparkle's update window. - Show a small red dot in the menu bar when an update to a new major version is available. - Keep the last known update visible if a later check fails.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.8.1
item.description:
Changes

- Adapt all six themes to the horizontal desktop widget with dedicated 2:1 layouts, preserving their colors and indicators. - Keep the widget layout independent of the popup height and show when previous data is displayed.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.8.0
item.description:
Changes

- Add a horizontal macOS desktop widget that displays the five-hour and weekly limits using the selected panel theme. Desktop widgets require macOS 14 or later; macOS controls their refresh timing. - Add a movable Picture-in-Picture window with the same themes and live limits, available from the menu bar context menu. Its position and visibility are saved. - Keep the latest widget snapshot in a local shared container and show previous data when a refresh fails.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.7.4
item.description:
Changes

- Keep the limits panel visible when Settings is open, including when clicking outside or switching apps. - Continue to allow closing the panel using the menu bar icon or Escape.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.7.3
item.description:
Changes

- Fix the limits panel reopening when clicking the menu bar icon while Settings is open. - Keep dismissing the panel by clicking outside it or pressing Escape.

item.title: Codex Bar 1.7.2
item.description:
Changes

- Show the release's Changes in the update window before installation. - Include the GitHub release notes in the update feed when preparing future releases.
